By creating an account or using the service, you agree to them... © 2026 BlazorData.net"*. BlazorData.Net collects and uses your personal information to operate the BlazorData.Net Web site and deliver the services you have requested."*
  * **Developer / Publisher Identification:** Microsoft Store and GitHub listings identify the publisher and developer directly as **BlazorData.net**, created and maintained by founder **Michael Washington**.
